turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
• AI Assistant
Orders are currently taking an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. You’ll receive an email with your tracking number as soon as your order is ready to go or once the shipping label is created.
Business days are Monday through Friday and do not include weekends or holidays. After shipment, transit time depends on location: 1–3 days for the West Coast, 3–4 days for Central US, 4–5 days for the Midwest, and 5–7 days for the East Coast.

turns.replyTail:

Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
Yes—expedited shipping is available for an extra fee at checkout.
A few important notes:
- It doesn’t speed up processing time
- After an order is placed, shipping speed can’t be changed
- If your order hasn’t been packed yet, you may be able to cancel and reorder with expedited shipping
- Delivery dates aren’t guaranteed
